Url.description_en:
The streaming URL.

The streaming URL is an unsigned URL. If the bucket ACL is not public-read-write, you must sign the URL before you can access it.
The playback URL is an unsigned URL. If the bucket ACL is private, you must sign the URL before you can access it

播放地址是未加签名的URL，如Bucket ACL为private，则需先进行签名才可访问

LiveChannelPublishUrls.title: A short description of struct

description_en: Creates a LiveChannel. You must create a LiveChannel before uploading audio and video data by using the RTMP protocol
description_zh: 通过RTMP协议上传音视频数据前，必须先创建一个LiveChannel
name: PutLiveChannel

parameters.help_en: The channel name. The name cannot contain forward slashes (/)
parameters.help_zh: 频道名称。不能包含斜杠（/）
parameters.name: channel

fields.help_en: The description of the LiveChannel. The description can be up to 128 bytes in length
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The status of the LiveChannel.

Valid values: enabled, disabled
Default value: enabled
fields.help_zh:
指定LiveChannel的状态。

有效值：enabled、disabled
默认值：enabled
fields.name: status

fields.help_en:
The type of streaming storage.

Valid values: HLS

When the streaming storage type is HLS, OSS updates the m3u8 file after each ts file is generated. The m3u8 file contains up to the most recent FragCount ts files.
When the streaming storage type is HLS, after the duration of audio and video data written to the current ts file reaches the duration specified by FragDuration, OSS switches to the next ts file upon receiving the next key frame. If the next key frame is not received after max(2*FragDuration, 60s), OSS forcibly switches the file, which may cause playback stuttering
fields.help_zh:
指定转储的类型。

有效值：HLS

转储类型为HLS时，OSS会在生成每个ts文件后更新m3u8文件。m3u8文件中最多包含最近的FragCount个ts文件。
转储类型为HLS时，写入当前ts文件的音视频数据时长达到FragDuration指定的时长后，OSS会在收到下一个关键帧的时切换到下一个ts文件；如果max(2*FragDuration,
                                          60s)后仍未收到下一个关键帧，OSS将强制切换文件，此时可能引起播放时卡顿
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The duration of each ts file when Type is set to HLS.
Unit: seconds.

Valid values: [1, 100].
Default value: 5.
The default values of FragDuration and FragCount take effect only when neither is specified. If one is specified, the other must also be specified
fields.help_zh:
当Type为HLS时，指定每个ts文件的时长。
单位：秒

取值范围：[1, 100]
默认值：5
FragDuration和FragCount的默认值只有在两者都未指定时才会生效；指定了其中一个，则另一个的值也必须指定
fields.name: frag_duration

fields.help_en:
The number of ts files contained in the m3u8 file when Type is set to HLS.

Valid values: [1, 100].
Default value: 3.
The default values of FragDuration and FragCount take effect only when neither is specified. If one is specified, the other must also be specified
fields.help_zh:
当Type为HLS时，指定m3u8文件中包含ts文件的个数。

取值范围：[1, 100]
默认值：3
FragDuration和FragCount的默认值只有在两者都未指定时才会生效；指定了其中一个，则另一个的值也必须指定
fields.name: frag_count

fields.help_en:
The name of the generated m3u8 file when Type is set to HLS. The name must end with ".m3u8" and be 6 to 128 characters in length.

Default value: playlist.m3u8.
Valid values: [6, 128]
fields.help_zh:
当Type为HLS时，指定生成的m3u8文件的名称。必须以”.m3u8”结尾，长度范围为[6, 128]。

默认值：playlist.m3u8
取值范围：[6, 128]
fields.name: playlist_name

fields.help_en: The container that stores the streaming storage configuration
fields.name: target

fields.help_en: The name of the role used for the high-frequency snapshot operation. The role must have write permissions on DestBucket and permissions to send messages to NotifyTopic
fields.help_zh: 用于高频截图操作的角色名称，要求有DestBucket的写权限和向NotifyTopic发消息的权限
fields.name: role_name

fields.help_en: The destination bucket for storing high-frequency snapshots. The bucket must have the same owner as the current bucket
fields.help_zh: 保存高频截图目标Bucket，要求与当前Bucket是同一个Owner
fields.name: dest_bucket

fields.help_en: The MNS topic used to notify users of the high-frequency snapshot operation results
fields.help_zh: 用于通知用户高频截图操作结果的MNS的Topic
fields.name: notify_topic

fields.help_en:
The interval for high-frequency snapshots. If no keyframe (I-frame) exists within the interval, no snapshot is captured during that interval.

Unit: seconds.

Valid values: [1, 100]
fields.help_zh:
高频截图的间隔长度。如果该段间隔时间内没有关键帧（I 帧），那么该间隔时间不截图。
单位：秒
取值范围：[1, 100]
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The container for the Snapshot options of the high-frequency snapshot operation
fields.help_zh: 保存高频截图操作Snapshot 选项的容器
fields.name: snapshot
